d.en: The default ending. After defeating the Elden Beast, the Tarnished mends the Elden Ring as it is and becomes Elden Lord.
d.pt: O final padrão. Depois de derrotar a Elden Beast, o Maculado conserta o Elden Ring como está e se torna Elden Lord.

en: Reach the Elden Throne after Crumbling Farum Azula and Leyndell, Ashen Capital.
Defeat Radagon of the Golden Order and the Elden Beast.
At Marika's shattered body, choose to mend the ring without a Mending Rune.
pt: Chegue ao Elden Throne depois de Crumbling Farum Azula e Leyndell, Ashen Capital.
Derrote Radagon of the Golden Order e a Elden Beast.
Diante do corpo partido de Marika, conserte o anel sem usar uma Mending Rune.

d.en: Ranni's ending. The Tarnished stands aside and Ranni leads the Lands Between into an age guided by the moon and the stars.
d.pt: O final de Ranni. O Maculado abre caminho e Ranni conduz as Terras Intermédias a uma era guiada pela lua e pelas estrelas.

en: Complete Ranni's questline up to handing her the Dark Moon Ring at the Cathedral of Manus Celes.
At the end, ring the bell next to the throne to summon Ranni.
pt: Conclua a missão de Ranni até entregar o Dark Moon Ring a ela na Cathedral of Manus Celes.
No final, toque o sino ao lado do trono para chamar Ranni.

d.en: The Tarnished accepts the Frenzied Flame from the Three Fingers and burns everything down, including Melina's hopes.
d.pt: O Maculado aceita a Chama Frenética dos Três Dedos e queima tudo, incluindo as esperanças de Melina.

en: Before the Erdtree burns, go down to the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds below Leyndell.
Pass the Frenzied Flame Proscription door with no armor on and accept the flame from the Three Fingers.
Defeat the Elden Beast; the ending happens on its own.
pt: Antes de a Erdtree queimar, desça aos Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, abaixo de Leyndell.
Passe pela porta da Frenzied Flame Proscription sem armadura e aceite a chama dos Três Dedos.
Derrote a Elden Beast; o final acontece sozinho.

d.en: Goldmask's ending. The Elden Ring is mended with the Mending Rune of Perfect Order, freeing the Golden Order from the gods' whims.
d.pt: O final de Goldmask. O Elden Ring é consertado com a Mending Rune of Perfect Order, livrando a Ordem Dourada dos caprichos dos deuses.

en: Follow Brother Corhyn and Goldmask on the Altus Plateau.
Solve the riddle of the Law of Regression in Leyndell and tell them.
Get the Mending Rune of Perfect Order from Goldmask after the Erdtree burns.
Use the rune at the end, after the Elden Beast.
pt: Acompanhe Brother Corhyn e Goldmask no Altus Plateau.
Resolva o enigma da Law of Regression em Leyndell e conte a eles.
Pegue a Mending Rune of Perfect Order com Goldmask depois que a Erdtree queimar.
Use a runa no final, depois da Elden Beast.

d.en: Fia's ending. The Mending Rune of the Death-Prince brings Destined Death back to the Lands Between.
d.pt: O final de Fia. A Mending Rune of the Death-Prince devolve a Morte Destinada às Terras Intermédias.

en: Accept Fia's embrace at Roundtable Hold and follow her requests until she leaves the Hold.
Find her in Deeproot Depths and defeat Lichdragon Fortissax.
Take the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince from her and use it at the end.
pt: Aceite o abraço de Fia na Roundtable Hold e siga os pedidos dela até ela deixar o lugar.
Encontre-a em Deeproot Depths e derrote Lichdragon Fortissax.
Pegue com ela a Mending Rune of the Death-Prince e use no final.

d.en: The Dung Eater's ending. The Mending Rune of the Fell Curse spreads his curse to everyone born in the new age.
d.pt: O final do Dung Eater. A Mending Rune of the Fell Curse espalha a maldição dele por todos que nascerem na nova era.

en: Find the Dung Eater at Roundtable Hold and later in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.
Collect five Seedbed Curses and give them to him.
Take the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse and use it at the end.
pt: Encontre o Dung Eater na Roundtable Hold e depois nos Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.
Junte cinco Seedbed Curses e entregue a ele.
Pegue a Mending Rune of the Fell Curse e use no final.
